_comment: tier 'marque' = big brands shown on the main pages and on Telegram; tier 'boutique' = small shops, shown in their own section. sale_only = we read only the shop's sale listings (its share of catalog on sale is then not measured). Platform 'decathlon' is read with a headless Chromium (collector/browser.py). skip_other = drop items that are not clothing, shoes or bags. Check a new shop first with: python collect.py --detect <domain>
_not_readable_yet: Refuse requests that identify as a bot (HTTP 403): adidas.co.ma, defacto.com, parfois.ma, Lefties. No own Moroccan online shop found: Celio, Beauty Success, Faces (Glovo only). Zara (platform 'zara' is built and tested, but zara.com refuses requests that identify as a bot; needs Inditex's permission or a feed). Blocked by anti-bot protection when read from a server (Nov 2026): Pull&Bear, Bershka, Stradivarius, Massimo Dutti, Oysho, Lefties (Inditex itxrest API behind Akamai), Mango (Vercel checkpoint), H&M, Lacoste.com, DeFacto, Marjane Mall and Jumia official stores (Nike, Adidas, Celio, DeFacto).
